text:
Alex R: Starting a short LON2 GPU fleet probe now — running a light battery: node health, GPU presence, NVLink checks, tiny compile+infer. Ping if you want to join.
Maria G: Do we have quota in LON2 for a 4xA100 pool? Thought we only had 2 reserved.
Sam K: We pushed a quota request last week, approved but not allocated. I'll trigger allocation now.
deploy-bot: Allocation request #QA-348 submitted. Status: pending.
Jin L: Note: network ACLs for LON2 need 10.8.0.0/16 allowed to monitoring cluster or healthchecks will fail.
Alex R: Good call. Maria, can you confirm firewall rule change?
Maria G: Confirmed — rule added in cloud console, propagation ~2m.
Alex R: Running the healthcheck script now: 
```bash
# quick probe
./scripts/cluster_probe.sh --region lon2 --gpus 4 --tests node,gpu,nvlink,infer
```
Sam K: Seeing one failing node: gpu-07 shows ECC and Xid errors, pulling logs.
Alex R: Paste the dmesg/kernel snippet if you have it.
Sam K: ```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU exception on gpu-07
[ 1234.568001] GPU: ECC correctable error on device 0
[ 1234.568210] gpu-07: hwmon sensor read failure
```
Nora P: If it's flaky, cordon gpu-07 to avoid scheduling expensive jobs until replaced.
Sam K: cordoned gpu-07 -> `kubectl cordon gpu-07` (done).
Alex R: Re-running tiny inference test (mini-transformer) on 3 nodes now.
Sam K: Mini-infer results -> p50 12ms, p95 28ms, p99 1.9ms, error-rate 0.3%.
Alex R: Inter-node latency quick check: iPerf shows intra-rack ~0.45ms, cross-rack ~1.8ms. That's within our soft SLO.
Maria G: For gating: p99 < 2ms, inference error-rate < 1%, all nodes healthy or cordoned. Current state meets gate except we have one cordoned node.
Alex R: Handing off to oncall for final sign-off and replacement plan. @deploy-bot please create handoff ticket.
deploy-bot: Ticket INFRA-HANDOFF-712 created, assignee @platform-oncall. Link: https://issues/redwood/INFRA-HANDOFF-712
Jin L: Cost note — enabling 10% burst capacity for LON2 (to handle peak warmups) adds approx $2.6k/month. Approve?
Nora P: :thumbsup: I'll include in the monthly showback and route for finance approval.
Alex R: Next steps: replace GPU on gpu-07 or RMA, re-run the mini-infer smoke, confirm SLOs, then flip cluster to active routing. Closing this thread when oncall confirms sign-off. Thanks everyone.
